353:t_1:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Hey, looks like you've calmed down.」

353:t_1:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Just call me $$クロウ$$. And don't you dare call me the $$揺れる天秤$$.」

353:t_1:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Compared to that, being in debt or born to draw the short straw is still a better deal.」

353:t_1:9.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Ah... no, just forget it for now.」

353:t_1:10.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You'll figure it out sooner or later anyway, like it or not.」

353:t_1:12.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I figured you'd be the delicate type by the look of you, but you've got a good smile.」

353:t_1:13.en:
$n
「The smile is thanks to $$ランド$$'s training.」

353:t_1:14.en:
$$クロウ$$
「And your piloting technique is $$セツコ$$'s $$グローリー・スター$$ style, huh?」

353:t_1:16.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I took a look at your data. I may not look it, but I've made my living piloting machines.」

353:t_1:17.en:
$$デュオ$$
「What are you talking about!? You could barely eat, what with paying off your debts!」

353:t_1:18.en:
$$青山$$
「Cut it out, $$デュオ$$. Even sugar water is an important meal for $$クロウ$$.」

353:t_1:20.en:
$n
「Um... you've been through a lot, haven't you, mostly money-wise...」

353:t_1:21.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Thanks for being considerate. ...Not that it's a thank-you, but as your senior in Reactors, I ought to give you something too...」

353:t_1:22.en:
$$クルツ$$
「$n! If you're going to ask him for something, ask for anything but money!」

353:t_1:23.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Even if you asked, you couldn't shake a single G out of $$クロウ$$ if you turned him upside down.」

353:t_1:26.en:
$$クロウ$$
「No... it's all right. I'm giving you something other than money. ...They're words I was taught when I enlisted in the military.」

353:t_1:27.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Frustration makes a man. Misery makes a man. Sorrow makes a man...」

353:t_1:29.en:
$$クロウ$$
「And a powerful enemy is what truly makes you a great man... Those are the words of an ace from a war long ago.」

353:t_1:30.en:
$n
「You're the second person to teach me that saying.」

353:t_1:31.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Blew it... I try to drop some words of wisdom on a youngster, and someone's already beaten me to it...」

353:t_1:32.en:
$n
「No... thank you. Thanks to you, I feel the strength to keep living welling up in me again.」

353:t_1:33.en:
$$クロウ$$
「By the way, who was the first?」

353:t_1:34.en:
$n
「My father. He taught me survival skills, Jeet Kune Do, and the strength to live.」

353:t_1:35.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Jeet Kune Do, huh... So that's the base of your unit's movements.」

353:t_1:36.en:
$$クロウ$$
「All right... Once things settle down, let's have a match. You against my Systema.」

353:t_1:37.en:
$n
「My old man says there's no way the $$人革連$$'s health calisthenics can beat Jeet Kune Do, the martial art of the whole person... That's what he says.」

353:t_1:38.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Interesting... Let's knock some of the cockiness out of this brash youngster.」

353:t_1:39.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What are you two doing, $n and $$クロウ$$ both!? Everyone has already gathered in the briefing room!」

353:t_1:41.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Honestly... Just because you've stopped being so much the quiet type doesn't mean you can get away with not acting as a team, you know.」

353:t_1:42.en:
$n
「Understood. ...$$クロウ$$... I'm looking forward to our match, you know.」

353:t_1:43.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Yeah. Let's get the briefing out of the way first.」

353:t_1:44.en:
$$クロウ$$
(Looks like we both have a weakness for older beauties with glasses, $n...)

353:t_1:45.en:
$$クロウ$$
(But Jeet Kune Do, huh... So your old man wanted to train your heart even more than your body...)

353:t_1:46.en:
$$クロウ$$
(I'll be expecting great things. From you, the one $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ entrusted his hope to.)

353:t_1:51.en:
$$万丈$$
「...First of all, I'm delighted to welcome you all back to the solar system.」

353:t_1:52.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Sorry about that, $$万丈$$. I shouldn't have asked you to arrange our passage from Mars to the $$地球圏$$.」

353:t_1:53.en:
$$万丈$$
「Please don't worry about it. More importantly, I must first let all of you know the situation on $$蒼の地球$$.」

353:t_1:54.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「About a month and a half since we were caught in the $$時空震動$$... What has happened during that time?」

353:t_1:55.en:
$$万丈$$
「The war between the $$新地球皇国$$ and the $$地球連邦$$, plus $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s aid and $$アマルガム$$'s scheming, is going the Empire's way by a wide margin.」

353:t_1:56.en:
$$ギャリソン$$
「Then allow me to show you all the current distribution of the Empire's forces.」

353:t_1:57.en:
$$ギャリソン$$
「Forgive me for not introducing myself sooner. I am $$ギャリソン時田$$, butler to $$破嵐万丈$$.」

353:t_1:59.en:
$$シャア$$
「The Empire controls 83.3%... I was prepared for it, but I never imagined it would be this bad.」

353:t_1:60.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Almost the entire Earth is under their control!」

353:t_1:61.en:
$$宗介$$
「It seems the only places still putting up a real fight are around Japan and the $$新世界大陸$$.」

353:t_1:62.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Even North America, where the main force of the $$地球連邦$$ remained, has been almost completely subdued...」

353:t_1:63.en:
$$ガロード$$
「If we're unlucky, the Earth won't hold out until we get back there!?」

353:t_1:64.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
(The Colonel... I mean, the Brigadier General is safe, right...)

353:t_1:65.en:
$$カレン$$
($$ポタリア$$, $$キデーラ$$... Did they get taken out too...?)

353:t_1:66.en:
$$万丈$$
「Of course, even in the areas placed under the Empire's control, guerrilla-style resistance continues.」

353:t_1:67.en:
$$万丈$$
「And as long as the Empire rules by points and lines, the $$ターミナル・ベース$$s and the $$レイライン$$s linking them, taking those down could turn it all around at once.」

353:t_1:68.en:
$$アルト$$
「So you're saying the Earth isn't finished yet.」

353:t_1:70.en:
$$勝平$$
「$c is all together again, and we've got new comrades too!」

353:t_1:71.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Once we're back on Earth, it's time to strike back!」

353:t_1:72.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...But this isn't an opponent we can beat without a plan.」

353:t_1:73.en:
$$レド$$
「Agreed. We must not forget our defeat at $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

353:t_1:74.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Back then we bet on our breakthrough power, but their strength exceeded even what $$ゼロ$$ and $$スメラギ$$ had estimated.」

353:t_1:75.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Without the support of Colonel $$シャア$$ and $$葵$$ and the others, we'd have been finished right there.」

353:t_1:76.en:
$$赤木$$
「But we've already gathered all the forces we can. There's nothing more we can do.」

353:t_1:77.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then all that's left is to come up with a way to win with the forces we have now.」

353:t_1:79.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We look for one... If there isn't one, we make one.」

353:t_1:80.en:
$$ノノ$$
「S-so cool...! That's exactly what a hero of justice is!」

353:t_1:81.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I wonder... It feels kind of desperate to me.」

353:t_1:82.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「That's not it, $$ラルク$$. Never giving up until the very last moment and aiming for victory... That's effort and guts.」

353:t_1:83.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノリコ$$ is exactly right, Big Sis.」

353:t_1:84.en:
$$ラルク$$
「...I can't keep up with this.」

353:t_1:85.en:
$$葵$$
「Normally, you'd think that way, wouldn't you...」
